notes: Separate self-contained project folder, sibling to the main repo's production temp_gravity_module PCB pipeline. Firmware port tracked in firmware/fermentation_tilt_v1_esp8266/. All 4 original hardware-verification items (TP4056 protection, GY-291 SDO/CS, D0-RST SLEEP jumper, A0 onboard divider) resolved against the user's physical boards as of 2026-09-19; battery_sense.py R1/R2 redesigned (330k/100k -> 10k/22k) as a two-stage divider once the A0 onboard divider was confirmed present on this clone. sensor_bus.py's DS18B20 TO-92 probe (too bulky for a PCB-mounted build) replaced with an MCP9808 I2C breakout sharing the GY-291's bus (wiring-only change, firmware already auto-detects MCP9808 first); d1_mini.py's D6/D7 pins and sensor_bus.py's GY-291 CS pin needed NOCONNECT/symio schematic-render-only fixes to work around two netlistsvg/elkjs crashes with scratch-built parts.
